name: notes
description: Quick personal notes in a local SQLite store (data/notes.db): 'note: the meeting moved to 5', 'show my notes', 'find the note about the projector', 'delete the note about X'. Notes are private, local, never leave the PC; search is exact-word based (no model call).
route: note that, make a note, show my notes, find my note about, delete the note, my notes list
